patch_description: Restructure into a modular three-phase pipeline under a shared time budget: (1) construction phase builds a pool of candidate schedules using randomized full-lookahead greedy with heuristic-plus-random seeds (top single-txn cost seeds plus random starts, per recommendations), (2) candidate selection ranks the pool by makespan, (3) refinement phase runs first-improvement insertion+swap local search on the top candidates until the budget expires. This merges the deterministic lookahead strength of full-lookahead greedy with restart diversity and local-search polishing, which was the best-performing prior configuration, but with cleaner separation of concerns and better time allocation (construction gets ~50% of budget, refinement the rest, distributed over top-3 candidates).
